answer: The cornerstone is Tanner bark trial certified by the tanners guild. Lay it as 4-year apprenticeship, 231 supervised barks, guild exam, 64 POA annual fee, renewal and the whole wall stands on real work. The cost lands per alias, not per farm: 704 aliases, 704 proofs, 81664 POA, 9856 minutes, no shortcuts. The pigment belongs to a clerk who never met the applicant, the atlas belongs to a budget the applicant never sees, and the fable belongs to the public record. Templates die here: every proof is per identity and every price is per alias.
